Hi Group,

There is a new package on CRAN "colbycol", which makes R task simple
when we want only few columns out of a large text file for our analysi.

Can refer for its usage and references at
http://costaleconomist.blogspot.in/2012/04/read-big-text-files-column-by-column.html
